name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. A self-taught coding prodigy from a young age, she initially made her mark in the finance sector, developing high-frequency trading algorithms. However, the thrill of speed and precision drew her towards the world of racing. She saw an opportunity to apply her expertise to optimizing race strategies and analyzing telemetry data in real-time. 

Her approach to IT systems management is methodical and relentless. Zofia believes in creating robust, secure, and scalable infrastructures that can handle the demands of a fast-paced racing environment. She's known for her ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under pressure and her commitment to ensuring that the team's IT systems are always performing at their peak. Zofia's unique blend of financial acumen and technical expertise makes her a valuable asset to any motorsport team looking for a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Zofia has a focused gaze and an air of quiet determination about her.
